paragraphs: Hillel the patriarch, son of Rabbi Yehudah Nesia, instituted intercalation according to Rav Adda’s seasons (see his entry). At its end Yuchasin writes: with him ordination ceased, when the wicked power decreed that whoever ordained would be killed. This Rabbi Hillel, his court, Israel’s sages, the heads of the ancestral houses, and the elders of that generation arose and established for us, through the tradition and reception in their possession, this correct and properly arranged calculation handed down from them for fixing new moons and the Lord’s sacred appointed times. This was near the end of the Talmudic sages’ days. From the beginning of the Mishnaic sages’ words, near the Second Temple’s construction, until the compilation of the Mishnah was completed in our holy master’s days, was 530 years. End of quotation. He was in Rabbah’s and Abaye’s time (I did not find it). Rabbi Shimon Duran likewise writes in his Azharot commentary: it was in year 670 of contracts, which is 4118 from creation, 290 after the destruction. After him there was no further court. He was the tenth generation from Hillel the Elder (see our holy master), and with him the patriarchate ceased (see Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel the Elder and part 1,year 4118, what is written there).
